description: This file defines the EmployeePictureModel class within the OrangeHRM project. It implements the Normalizable interface and uses traits for serialization. The class constructs a model to represent employee picture data, including attributes like employee number, filename, file type, size, width, and height, based on the EmpPicture entity. It appears to be used for API serialization/deserialization within the Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: EmployeePictureModel
classes.description: A model class for representing employee picture data in the API layer, encapsulating serialization details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with an EmpPicture entity and sets up filters and attribute names for serialization.
